params.command: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop'; $opt=New-CimSessionOption -Protocol Dcom; $s=New-CimSession -ComputerName heaven2 -SessionOption $opt -OperationTimeoutSec 8; try{$os=Get-CimInstance -CimSession $s -ClassName Win32_OperatingSystem -OperationTimeoutSec 8; $r=Invoke-CimMethod -CimSession $s -ClassName Win32_Process -MethodName Create -Arguments @{CommandLine='schtasks.exe /Run /TN "Heaven Local Bridge"'} -OperationTimeoutSec 8; [pscustomobject]@{caption=$os.Caption;return_value=$r.ReturnValue;process_id=$r.ProcessId}|ConvertTo-Json -Compress} finally {Remove-CimSession $s}
